analysis: The supplied units are base-side text of SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift (lines 1756-3038). Base content is existing test code: ready-receipt matrix, write-behind failure barriers, staging-reservation release paths, root isolation under darkbloom/kv3, and whole-root maintenance. These tests exercise controls relevant to T-041: HMAC-keyed names, TTL and LRU eviction, free-space reserve, corrupt-file suppression, and reservation release at endAdoption/completeStaging. The PR changes only test files visible here, so no production security behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The new head tests describe a maintainer header-verdict cache keyed on unchanged files, with the test text noting ctime. Test-only changes cannot regress production, but the matching production change in SSDWholeRootMaintainer (verdict memoization keyed on size, mtime and ctime) is not in this batch. A next pass should check that the production change cannot let a stale ownership verdict cause deletion of non-owned files or skipped cleanup, and that memoization is invalidated on inode, ctime or size change.
